movie.name: Avengers: Doomsday
movie.description: The Marvel multiverse stands on the brink of collapse as iconic heroes from different universes are forced into an epic battle against Doctor Doom. Survival demands unlikely alliances in the MCU's biggest crossover yet.

cast_info.cast_bio: Topping the Forbes list of Hollywood's highest-paid actors for three consecutive years, Robert Downey Jr. achieved critical and popular success with his portrayal of Tony Stark/ Iron Man in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. His performance as Chaplin in 1993 won him the BAFTA. He has also been awarded the Golden Globe and the MTV Movie Awards for his performances in a variety of different films and television shows including Heart and Souls, Iron Man 3, The Avengers and Sherlock Holmes to name a few.

Chris Hemsworth is an Australian actor who gained international recognition with the portrayal of Thor in Marvel movies since 2011. He has also acted in several TV series prior to which he was a popular contestant in the Australian version of Dancing with the Stars. Some of his most well known movies include the horror comedy The Cabin in the Woods and the dark-fantasy action film Snow White and the Huntsman. He has also appeared in the sci-fi action film Star Trek in 2009.

Chris Evans is an American actor, best known for playing superheroes Captain America and the Human Torch in Marvel movies. He started his acting career on television, playing a significant character in the 2000 series Opposite Sex. Prior to his mainstream performances, Evans dedicatedly acted in school productions and participated in community theater. Then, he moved to New York and attended the Lee Strasberg Theater Institute. He won several awards for his superhero roles. He also turned to direction with the drama film Before We Go.

Best known for appearing in shows like Game of Thrones, Law & Order, The Mentalist, Homeland and Narcos, Pedro Pascal is a Chilean- American actor. He has studied acting at the Orange County School of the Arts and New York University's Tisch School of the Arts. Closely associated with theater, Pascal has won several awards for his stage performances.

Paul Rudd is an American actor, comedian, writer and producer who made his acting debut with NBC's drama series Sisters. He rose to widespread popularity playing the role of Mike in the hugely successful sitcom Friends and went on to star in movies like The 40-year Old Virgin, The Fundamentals of Caring and Marvel’s Ant-Man series. He has won several awards and accolades for his performances and is closely associated with theater. Rudd is a graduate of the American Academy of Dramatic Arts-West in Los Angeles and has also studied at the University of Kansas, majoring in theater.
Anthony Dwane Mackie is an American actor. Mackie made his acting debut starring in the semi-biographical drama film 8 Mile

Rose to fame from Lady Macbeth, Florence Paul is a successful actress. From the city of Oxfordshire to Hollywood her journey has been incredible. She has worked in so many amazing ventures which include Fighting with My Family (2019), The Falling (2014), Midsommar (2019), and Outlaw King (2018). The next movie in which Florence Pugh will be seen is Black Widow.

Vanessa Kirby is a popular stage, television and film actor. Her debut movie was Love/Loss in 2010. She became a household name after appearing in the BBC adaptation of Great Expectations in 2011. Some of her popular movies are About Time, The Exchange, Everest, Genius, Kill Command and Me Before You.

Letitia Wright is a British actress who primarily appears in British TV series like Black Mirror, Doctor Who, Glasgow Girls, Top Boy and Chasing Shadows. Her major film role that gained her worldwide recognition is that of Shuri in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Her performance in Black Panther has earned her critical acclaim and is being applauded as a brand new definition to the idea of a “Disney Princess.”

Simu Liu is a Canadian actor, writer, and stuntman. He is known for his performance as Jung Kim in the award-winning CBC Television sitcom Kim's Convenience. He received nominations at the ACTRA Awards and Canadian Screen Awards for his work in Blood and Water.

Winston Duke is a Tobagonian actor who started his career with theater productions for Portland Stage Company and Yale Repertory Theatre. He was soon cast in the crime-drama series Person of Interest and then, entered the Marvel Cinematic Universe as M’Baku in Black Panther and other movies including Avengers: Infinity War. He has also appeared on other popular TV shows like Law & Order and Modern Family. He attended Yale School of Drama with fellow star Lupita Nyong’O and went to school with YouTube star Jenna Marbles.

Sebastian Stan was born on August 13, 1982, in Constanta, Romania. He moved with his mother to Vienna, Austria, when he was eight, and then to New York when he was twelve. Stan studied at Rutgers Mason Gross School of the Arts and spent a year at Shakespeare's Globe Theatre in London.

A former ice-hockey player, Wyatt Russell is an American actor who made his first film appearance as an orphan boy in 1996’s Escape from L.A. He went on to appear in films like Love and Honor, 22 Jump Street, Table 19, Shimmer Lake and Everybody Wants Some!!

Sir Patrick Stewart OBE is an English actor who has a career spanning six decades in various stage productions, television, film and video games. He has been nominated for Olivier, Tony, Golden Globe, Emmy, Screen Actors Guild, and Saturn Awards.

Channing Tatum is an American actor best known for films like She’s The Man, Step Up, 21 Jump Street, Dear John, The Vow and Logan Lucky. Having made his Hollywood debut with Coach Carter, Tatum had got his big break in Ricky Martin's music video "She Bangs". He has won several awards and accolades for his performances and was chosen by People magazine as the Sexiest Man Alive in 2012. He is an accomplished dancer too and has lent his voice to popular characters in animated shows and film slike The Simpsons, The Lego Batman Movie, The Book of Life and Smallfoot among others.

Tenoch Huerta Mejía is a Mexican actor of Aztec and Purépecha origin. He has appeared in a number of movies in Latin America and Spain, starring in both feature films and short films. He is one of the actors featured in Mónica Maristain's book 30 Actors Made in Mexico.

Well known for his role as Jim Hopper in Sacred Games, David Harbour marked him as an excellent actor. Done his debut in the year 1999 David Harbour worked in many movies which include Hell Boy(2019), Suicide Squad(2016), The Equalizer(2014), Sleepless(2017), War of the Worlds(2005) and many more.

James Marsden is an American actor, singer, and model who started his career with television shows such as Boogie Diner (1994-1995) and Second Noah (1996-1997). He gained substantial recognition when he appeared as Cyclops in X-Men (2000) and went on to essay the role in the subsequent series. Later, James was seen in commercially hit films like The Notebook (2004) and Superman Returns (2006). In 2007, he appeared and lent his voice for characters in the musicals, Hairspray and Enchanted, following which he appeared in the romantic comedy 27 Dresses (2008). James also had a recurring role in the television series 30 Rock (2006-2013) and a cameo appearance in Modern Family (2009-present). Some of his popular films are The Butler (2013), and in Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues (2013) and was seen in Best of Me, which released in October 2014. His 2020 releases include Sonic The Hedgehog.
Lewis Pullman is an American actor who has appeared in films like Battle of the Sexes, The Strangers: Prey at Night and Aftermath. He is the son of actor Bill Pullman.

Allen Kelsey Grammer is an American actor. He gained fame for his role as psychiatrist Dr. Frasier Crane on the NBC sitcom Cheers and its spin-off Frasier, for which he received four Primetime Emmy Awards and two Golden Globe Awards. The role remains one of the longest running in television history.

Kathryn Newton is an American actress best known for her roles in films like Paranormal Activity 4, Bad Teacher and Lady Bird. She has also appeared on a variety of popular TV shows including Supernatural, Gary Unmarried, Halt and Catch Fire, Little Men and Big Little Lies. She has won several awards and accolades for her work.

Alan Cumming FRSE is a Scottish actor. His London stage work includes Hamlet, the Maniac in Accidental Death of an Anarchist, the lead in Bent, The National Theatre of Scotland's The Bacchae and Samuel Beckett's Endgame at The Old Vic, opposite Daniel Radcliffe.

Hannah Dominique E. John-Kamen is an English actress. She is known for her roles as Yalena "Dutch" Yardeen in the Syfy television series Killjoys, Ornela in the HBO series Game of Thrones, F'Nale Zandor

Hayley Atwell is a British-American actress. Her debut film was Cassandra`s Dream (2007). Hayley starred in commercially successful films like The Duchess (2008), Captain America: The First Avenger (2011), The Sweeney (2012) and Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014). She last appeared in Cinderella (2015), Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015) and Ant-Man (2015). Her 2018 release includes Christopher Robin.
